item.title: Willow Springs Man Injured in a Saturday Evening Crash
item.description: A 72-year-old Willow Springs man sustained moderate injuries Saturday evening in an accident three miles west of Mountain View on County Road 3400. The accident occurred when he tried to avoid another vehicle, ran off the road and struck a tree in a 2002 Chevy Silverado. He was transported to Ozars Healthcare for treatment. The post Willow Springs Man Injured in a Saturday Evening Crash appeared first on Ozark Radio News.
